title: The Bacchae

panels.visual: Dionysus (young, long dark curls, ivy crown, leopard skin) arriving at the gates of the city of Thebes disguised as a smiling stranger, a dangerous glint in his eye
panels.caption: Dionysus, god of wine and theatre, came home to Thebes in disguise.

panels.visual: King Pentheus (young, stern, crown, armour) pointing furiously while guards chain up the smiling stranger
panels.caption: His cousin, King Pentheus, said he was a fake and threw him in jail.

panels.visual: The chains snapping and the palace walls cracking and shaking, Dionysus walking out free and smiling, guards fleeing
panels.caption: Chains cannot hold a god.

panels.visual: The women of Thebes with wild eyes and ivy in their hair running up a dark mountain at night with torches and pine-cone staffs
panels.caption: He drove the women of Thebes wild. They ran up the mountain as Bacchae.

panels.visual: Frenzied Bacchae women on the mountain tearing at a huge wild bull with their bare hands, dark-red blood splashing everywhere, torches, horror
panels.caption: They danced, they shrieked, and they tore wild animals apart with their bare hands.

panels.visual: Agave, the king's mother (older woman, wild grey-streaked hair, ivy crown, blood-splashed dress), leading the pack with a pine-cone staff raised, eyes blazing
panels.caption: Their leader was Pentheus's own mother, Agave.

panels.visual: Dionysus slyly helping Pentheus into a long woman's dress and a wig, Pentheus looking dazed and excited
panels.caption: Dionysus tricked Pentheus into dressing as a woman, to spy on them.

panels.visual: Pentheus in his disguise peeking down from the top of a tall pine tree at the Bacchae dancing round a fire below, moonlight
panels.caption: He climbed a tall pine tree to watch.

panels.visual: The Bacchae all looking up at once with glowing white eyes; above them, in their frenzied vision, the man in the tree looks like a snarling mountain lion
panels.caption: In their frenzy, they did not see a king. They saw a mountain lion.

panels.visual: Dozens of hands pulling the whole pine tree down, Pentheus falling into the screaming crowd, dark-red blood splashing across the panel
panels.caption: They pulled the tree down and tore him apart.

panels.visual: Agave marching home through the city gates in triumph at dawn, holding up her staff with a dark round shape stuck on top, shown only as a black silhouette against the rising sun, people backing away in horror
panels.caption: Agave marched home proudly with her lion's head on her staff.

panels.visual: Extreme close-up of Agave's face as the frenzy leaves her: tiny shaking pupils, mouth open in a silent scream, tears, a drip of red on her cheek; behind her Dionysus fading into shadow, smiling
panels.caption: Then she saw whose head it was. Her own son's.

mood: Gothic horror mood for this story: wild night scenes on a mountain, torches, frenzied faces, deep black shadows, dark-red ink as the single accent colour; blood shown as splashes and drips, never wounds or body parts; frightening but suitable for brave children aged 9 to 11.
